covered_report_window.description: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Wednesday, November 4, 2026 U.S. close and before the Thursday, November 5, 2026 U.S. open

report_type: US1 full ranked earnings-event consensus report
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were sharply higher intraday while oil fell below $95; the tape remained sensitive to inflation, rate-hike risk, geopolitical headlines, and Friday's U.S. jobs report.

methodology.disparity_formula: round(1.5 * mean(population standard deviation of the three direction scores, population standard deviation of the three reversal-risk values)), capped at 100

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Datacenter optical demand and FY27 guide
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: AI-capex financing scare or margin miss
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A de-risked share price and accelerating datacenter demand create upside if capacity and gross-margin guidance validate the backlog.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $1.98 and options imply roughly a 12.5% move.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Strong datacenter growth, capacity execution, and margin expansion support a beat-and-raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A merely in-line outlook or weaker margin conversion confirms that AI demand was already discounted.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 12.5%, above the stock's recent average earnings move; shares were down about 6.8% intraday before the event.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public pre-event revision detail was limited; current analyst targets remain broadly bullish but are secondary to the guide.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Weak shipment absorption and a guided low-teens EBITDA decline leave the stock vulnerable unless sell-through and strategic-review commentary are clearly better than feared.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $0.12; company guidance was $0.11-$0.13 with gross margin down 50-100 basis points.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Better sell-through, more than $300 million first-half free cash flow, or strategic-review clarity sparks relief.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Persistent like-for-like weakness and margin deleverage undermine the promised FY27 progression.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Current event implied-move data was not available from a sufficiently reliable public source; the low share price raises squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The company has limited guidance to Q1 and first-half cash flow, leaving estimates unusually dependent on management tone.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Coach's double-digit momentum and low-teens FY27 EPS framework provide a credible beat path if tariffs do not erode gross margin.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $1.56; the options market prices roughly a 9.8% move.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Coach sustains double-digit growth, international demand holds, and FY27 guidance rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Tariff pressure and Kate Spade weakness offset Coach and cap the guide.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The roughly 9.8% implied move is close to the stock's historical earnings move, so a solid beat may be needed.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public previews are constructive and center on Coach as the earnings engine; precise revision breadth was not consistently available.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Sequential ad-platform growth and Q4 guide
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Another guide miss despite headline growth
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A 65% year-to-date drawdown and oversold positioning create relief upside, but only if the model-update narrative restores sequential growth and guidance credibility.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $3.94-$4.03 EPS on $2.08 billion revenue; options imply about 17%-18%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Revenue reaccelerates, EBITDA margins hold, and the Q4 guide shows model improvements working.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A second weak sequential guide or poorer-quality e-commerce expansion overwhelms strong year-over-year growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 17.6%; put/call activity was unusually bearish, but shares were already up about 11% intraday.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Three EPS estimates moved down in the prior 30 days, while most covering analysts still rate the shares Buy or Strong Buy.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Pharma/specialty profit and FY27 EPS guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Broad segment momentum, a 13%-15% FY27 EPS growth guide, and substantial buyback capacity support upside if specialty profit confirms the quality of the prior quarter.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is $2.92 and options imply about 6.2%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Specialty profit and Other segment growth sustain above-target EPS growth and enable a guide raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Prior tariff-refund benefits and valuation make an in-line quarter vulnerable to profit-taking.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 6.2%; shares were up about 2.5% intraday and trade near a premium multiple.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The latest company guidance sits above its long-term EPS growth target; public revision breadth was limited.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A reduced royalty-growth outlook and rapid R&D spending create downside risk at a demanding valuation, but AI CPU demand makes the bearish setup unusually reversible.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $0.47 and options imply roughly 11.8%-12.3%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Armv9 mix, data-center royalties, and AGI CPU demand clear the high bar and force a squeeze.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Mobile royalty growth softens while R&D absorbs the licensing upside and guidance stays near consensus.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 12%; the stock was down about 2.7% intraday, leaving less event-day crowding than APP.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 revenue guidance was $1.33-$1.43 billion and EPS $0.43-$0.51; full-year royalty growth had been reduced to about 18%.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Oil reversal or weak realized pricing
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Operational execution and capital-return capacity offer a modest upside edge after a sharp oil-led pullback, but the reaction will be dominated by forward commodity sensitivities.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $3.06 and options imply roughly 4.7%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Production and cost guidance improve while management protects distributions at current oil levels.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Weak realized prices, higher capex, or cautious buyback language outweigh production.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 4.7%; shares were down roughly 6% intraday as oil retreated, reducing but not eliminating macro risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Company released updated 2026 sensitivity and guidance materials in October; public estimate-revision breadth was not consistently available.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Paid subscription trajectory and EBITDA guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Continuing subscription erosion keeps the base case negative, but the very low bar and sensitivity to cost savings make a relief rally plausible.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public consensus detail was inconsistent; the market focus is ending paid connected-fitness subscriptions and FY27 adjusted EBITDA.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Churn improves, Cross Training gains traction, and cost discipline lifts the cash-flow outlook.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Paid subscriptions keep falling and product demand fails to offset price-led subscription revenue.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Reliable current implied-move data was unavailable; the low share price and turnaround positioning imply high squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Subscription revenue in FY26 rose only slightly because price increases offset falling paid subscriptions.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A premium valuation and leafy-greens traffic concern create downside if comps decelerate, but prior 9% same-store sales and positive traffic make the short case fragile.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $0.12 and options imply roughly 12.3%-12.6%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Traffic rebounds, new-unit productivity stays strong, and management raises the same-store-sales guide.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Traffic softens further and food/labor costs compress restaurant-level margins.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 12.6%; shares were up about 4.6% intraday and trade above 100 times trailing earnings.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The prior quarter's 9% same-store sales beat expectations, so the current bar is more demanding despite food-safety concerns.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Organic growth and margin after acquisition
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The valuation requires continued exceptional growth and clean margin conversion, while the company's 36% Q1 growth and raised outlook make a bearish call vulnerable.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $0.59; management raised FY27 sales-growth guidance to 18%-20% after Q1.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Core e.l.f. momentum and acquired-brand contribution drive another beat-and-raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Growth normalizes, debt and integration costs dilute earnings, or margins miss the high bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Reliable current event implied-move data was unavailable; shares were up about 5.1% intraday at roughly 120 times trailing earnings.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The raised 18%-20% sales outlook is a positive revision, but it also increases the hurdle for the quarter.
